<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NewMealOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestCall" name="Call for guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_Start" name="Feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Guest_ChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Guest_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_PlaceOrder" name="Place meal order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instructions" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_BuzzerRings_Def" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Guest_ReactToBuzzer" name="React to buzzer?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_ReceiveCall" name="Receive call">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_ReceiveCall_Def" messageRef="Message_GuestCall"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Guest_RespondToCall" name="Respond to call?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" name="Appear at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_ReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_ReceiveMeal_Def" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Guest_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Guest_End" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_1" sourceRef="Guest_Start" targetRef="Guest_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_2" sourceRef="Guest_ChooseDish" targetRef="Guest_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_3" sourceRef="Guest_WaitTurn" targetRef="Guest_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_4" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_5" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_6" sourceRef="Guest_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Guest_ReactToBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_React" sourceRef="Guest_ReactToBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">guestReactsToBuzzer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_NoReact" sourceRef="Guest_ReactToBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_CallToDecision" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveCall" targetRef="Guest_RespondToCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_Respond" sourceRef="Guest_RespondToCall" targetRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">guestRespondsToCall</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_NoResponse" sourceRef="Guest_RespondToCall" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_ArriveToReceive" sourceRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_Eat" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal" targetRef="Guest_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_End" sourceRef="Guest_EatMeal" targetRef="Guest_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Employee_OrderReceived" name="Meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_OrderReceived_Def" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Employee_EnterPOS" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Employee_CollectMoney" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Employee_SetupBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_PassBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer and explain that dinner is ready when it rings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_MealReady" name="Chef reports meal ready">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_MealReady_Def" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_RingBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" name="Wait for guest or 5 minutes" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_GuestAtHatch_Def" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer" name="5 minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer_Def">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Message_GuestCall"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Employee_End" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_1" sourceRef="Employee_OrderReceived" targetRef="Employee_EnterPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_2" sourceRef="Employee_EnterPOS" targetRef="Employee_CollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_3" sourceRef="Employee_CollectMoney" targetRef="Employee_SetupBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_4" sourceRef="Employee_SetupBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_PassBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_5" sourceRef="Employee_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_6" sourceRef="Employee_InformChef" targetRef="Employee_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_7" sourceRef="Employee_MealReady" targetRef="Employee_RingBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_8" sourceRef="Employee_RingBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_Guest" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_Timer" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_Call" sourceRef="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer" targetRef="Employee_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_CallAgain" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_Handover" sourceRef="Employee_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="Employee_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_End" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Employee_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Chef_OrderReceived" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Chef_OrderReceived_Def" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Chef_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Chef_PlaceMeal" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Chef_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is ready in service hatch" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Chef_End" name="Employee informed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_1" sourceRef="Chef_OrderReceived" targetRef="Chef_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_2" sourceRef="Chef_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Chef_PlaceMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_3" sourceRef="Chef_PlaceMeal" targetRef="Chef_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_4" sourceRef="Chef_InformEmployee" targetRef="Chef_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Restaurant_Collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Employee_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerHandover" sourceRef="Employee_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NewOrder" sourceRef="Employee_InformChef" targetRef="Chef_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" sourceRef="Chef_InformEmployee" targetRef="Employee_MealReady" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRings" sourceRef="Employee_RingBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveCall" messageRef="Message_GuestCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" sourceRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Employee_GuestAtHatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and readiness instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NewMealOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestCall" name="Call for guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_Start" name="Feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_EnterRestaurant" name="Enter restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_WaitTurn" name="Wait for turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_PlaceOrder" name="Place meal order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_Pay" name="Pay for meal" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and readiness instruction" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings; meal ready for collection">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_BuzzerRings_Def" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Guest_ReactToBuzzer" name="React to buzzer?" default="Guest_Flow_NoReact"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_ReceiveCall" name="Receive call">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_ReceiveCall_Def" messageRef="Message_GuestCall"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Guest_MergeResponse" name="Continue to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" name="Arrive at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>

rules.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules.situation: the description states a distinct action between other actions in an ordered process sequence

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity and provides criteria or other supporting details that are not needed to identify that activity: Label the BPMN element with a concise name for the stated action; omit supporting details that do not distinguish it from another modeled activity, while preserving details that are themselves distinct actions or alternatives.
rules.situation: the description gives an activity or event with explanatory details that are not needed to identify it

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant communicates with another participant or transfers an item to them: Model the message flow between elements that represent the described sender and receiver. Use a receiving event as an endpoint only when it represents receipt of that communication; do not substitute an unrelated activity or event for either endpoint.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant communicates with another participant or transfers an item to them

rules.instruction: Use an intermediate catch event when flow waits for a trigger and an intermediate throw event when flow emits or raises a result.
rules.situation: the description states that the process pauses until a specified trigger occurs before continuing

rules.instruction: When the description states a meaningful object, recipient, or responsible role for an activity: Use a concise BPMN label that preserves the described action and those details when they distinguish or clarify the activity.
rules.situation: the description states an action or event and identifies an object, outcome, or context that distinguishes it from related process elements

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes a notification from a later recipient response or arrival, and says a subsequent action depends on that later occurrence.: Model the response or arrival as the catching event that enables the subsequent action; do not use the notification itself as a substitute for that occurrence.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes a notification or signal from a later recipient response or arrival that enables subsequent work

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant communicates information to another participant and separately describes the recipient’s later reaction, arrival, or other action: Model the communication with a message flow from the sending participant’s communication element to an element that represents receipt of that communication; model the recipient’s later reaction or action separately in that participant’s process.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant communicates information to another participant and separately describes the recipient’s later reaction, arrival, or other action
